title: GET /health has no linked regression coverage
reasoning: The health route has observable behavior for the available-provider path, unavailable-provider 503 path via _get_provider, and exception-to-503 handling around payload construction, but the feature metadata includes no tests. That leaves the route contract easy to regress without detection.
recommendation: Add focused tests for GET /health covering a configured provider returning the healthy payload and a missing or failing provider returning HTTP 503.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the included owned file contains only the implementation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a pytest/FastAPI TestClient test module that overrides app.state.embedding_provider with a stub provider for the success case, clears it for the unavailable-provider case, and uses a provider that makes resolve_embedding_space_version fail for the unhealthy case.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests for backend/src/embeddings/service_app.py GET /health without changing production behavior.
